mapper.select: SELECT sa.*, si.name AS supply_name, si.code AS supply_code, u1.real_name AS applicant_name, u1.department AS applicant_department, u2.real_name AS approver_name FROM supply_application sa LEFT JOIN supply_item si ON sa.supply_id = si.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON sa.applicant_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON sa.approver_id = u2.id WHERE sa.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM supply_application WHERE status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supply_application (supply_id, quantity, purpose, applicant_id, status, apply_time) VALUES (#{supplyId}, #{quantity}, #{purpose}, #{applicantId}, 'PENDING', NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE supply_application SET status = #{status}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_time = NOW(), approve_remark = #{approveRemark}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
